dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, jagged perimeters. The high-contrast boundary transitions from the dark charcoal exterior into a speckled light-grey band that forms the ring shape, often enclosing a dark central region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of small, solid light-grey pixel clusters scattered primarily along the dorsal ridge and between the larger annuli, lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the upper lateral surface form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary arrangement of smaller annuli forms a roughly linear chain extending toward the posterior region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct series of five roughly parallel, vertically oriented linear depressions resembling rake marks are visible on the lower right lateral flank.
